Tornek-Rayville.name: TR-660
Tornek-Rayville.desc: A faithful revival of a rare 1960s US Navy SEAL dive watch, with a bead-blasted case and a plain matte black dial.

Tornek-Rayville.name: TR Type 7B "Blakjak"
Tornek-Rayville.desc: A compact military-style diver in two versions, a 60-minute dive timer or a 12-hour second time zone bezel.

Tornek-Rayville.name: Paradive
Tornek-Rayville.desc: A small, mid-century military diver with an acrylic crystal and more dial choices than the TR-660.

Sangin Instruments.name: Overlord
Sangin Instruments.desc: A tough quartz field watch that can also dive and track a second time zone, built by a veteran-run California brand.

Sangin Instruments.name: Professional
Sangin Instruments.desc: A rugged 300m diver with a second time zone hand and a choice of dive or GMT bezel.

Sangin Instruments.name: Kinetic II
Sangin Instruments.desc: A chunky tool diver; the titanium version is rated to 1000m, the deepest in the lineup.

Sangin Instruments.name: Atlas
Sangin Instruments.desc: A clean, everyday steel sport watch that sits between the brand's field and dive models.

Sangin Instruments.name: Neptune
Sangin Instruments.desc: The brand's more refined automatic diver, sized for everyday wear while keeping a tool-watch build.

Marathon.name: GSAR
Marathon.desc: The automatic search-and-rescue diver issued to militaries, with glowing tritium tubes and a 300m rating.

Marathon.name: TSAR / JSAR
Marathon.desc: Battery-powered versions of the military diver, built to be grab-and-go reliable with tritium lume.

Marathon.name: General Purpose Quartz (GPQ)
Marathon.desc: The plastic-cased field watch issued to the US military, light, cheap and very easy to read.

Marathon.name: General Purpose Mechanical (GPM)
Marathon.desc: A wind-up version of the classic issue field watch in a light composite case.

Marathon.name: Navigator
Marathon.desc: A lightweight pilot's watch with a rotating bezel, descended from watches issued to US Air Force aircrew.

Marathon.name: CSAR
Marathon.desc: A big military-spec dive chronograph with tritium lume, the heaviest-duty watch Marathon makes.

Christopher Ward.name: The Twelve
Christopher Ward.desc: An integrated-bracelet sport watch with a twelve-sided bezel and textured dial, at a fraction of luxury prices.

Christopher Ward.name: C60 Trident Pro 300
Christopher Ward.desc: The brand's flagship 300m diver, a well-finished Swiss automatic that rivals pricier dive watches.

Christopher Ward.name: C63 Sealander
Christopher Ward.desc: A light, simple everyday watch for travel and outdoors, now also offered with a second time zone.

Christopher Ward.name: C65 Trident
Christopher Ward.desc: A vintage-style diver with a narrow bezel and domed crystal, inspired by 1960s dive watches.

Christopher Ward.name: C1 Bel Canto
Christopher Ward.movement: Automatic with chiming module, Sellita base
Christopher Ward.desc: A watch that strikes a small bell every hour, a complication usually costing tens of thousands.

CWC.name: G10
CWC.desc: The British Army's issue field watch, a slim quartz watch with a plain black dial made since the 1970s.

CWC.name: G10 Fatboy-80
CWC.desc: A reissue of the thicker 1980s version of the G10, with a slightly chunkier case.

CWC.name: 1980 Royal Navy Diver
CWC.desc: A reissue of the dive watch CWC supplied to the Royal Navy in 1980, a real military diving tool.

CWC.name: Navy Eighty
CWC.desc: A modern take on the 1980s navy diver, made in small batches with more capable specs.

CWC.name: Chronograph
CWC.desc: A remake of the asymmetric chronograph issued to British military pilots since the 1970s.

Paulin.name: Modul
Paulin.desc: A Bauhaus-inspired watch sold with a choice of five dial designs, designed and assembled in Glasgow.

Paulin.name: Neo
Paulin.desc: A colourful everyday watch with bold numerals, launched with Scottish enamel makers anOrdain.

Paulin.name: Mara
Paulin.desc: A playful retro 300m dive watch that brings Paulin's graphic style to a serious Swiss automatic.

Paulin.name: OH no
Paulin.desc: A series of artist collaborations with cheeky printed dials, made to be fun rather than formal.

Isotope.name: Hydrium
Isotope.desc: A bright, fun dive watch famous for its signature drop of lume at six o'clock and playful limited editions.

Isotope.name: GMT 0º
Isotope.desc: A clean travel watch that shows a second time zone, the brand's take on an everyday GMT.

Isotope.name: Flyway
Isotope.desc: A compact, enamel-dial pilot's watch that wears small and stands out on the wrist.

Isotope.name: Mercury
Isotope.desc: A slim hand-wound dress watch with a regulated Swiss movement and artistic dials.

Isotope.name: Moonshot
Isotope.desc: The brand's top chronograph, a space-themed design that marks Isotope's move upmarket.

Circula.name: ProTrail
Circula.desc: A rugged German field and hiking watch with a compass-style bezel and 200m water resistance.

Circula.name: AquaSport II
Circula.desc: A vintage-flavoured diver with a ceramic bezel, a strong value pick from a family-run brand.

Circula.name: SuperSport
Circula.desc: A 1970s-style sporty diver with bright colours and an easy everyday size.

Circula.name: DiveSport Titanium
Circula.desc: A light titanium professional diver with a 500m rating, the brand's toughest model.

Circula.name: AquaSport GMT
Circula.desc: The dive watch with a second time zone hand added, for divers who travel.

Dekla.name: Pilot Type B
Dekla.desc: A traditional German WWII-style pilot's watch with the minute-focused Type B dial, made in Germany.

Dekla.name: Pilot Type A
Dekla.desc: The classic pilot's dial with large hour numerals, also offered in bronze.

Dekla.name: Deckwatch
Dekla.desc: A wristwatch styled like a ship's deck clock, with large Roman or Arabic numerals.

Dekla.name: Seaborn
Dekla.desc: The brand's dive watch, with fine adjustment of the movement done in-house.

Nivada Grenchen.name: Chronomaster
Nivada Grenchen.desc: A faithful remake of a 1960s chronograph with a rotating bezel, a cult classic among vintage fans.

Nivada Grenchen.name: Antarctic
Nivada Grenchen.desc: A simple vintage-style everyday watch, also in diver and GMT versions, the brand's most affordable line.

Nivada Grenchen.name: Depthmaster
Nivada Grenchen.desc: A retro dive watch, including the playful Pacman and Art Deco dial versions.

Nivada Grenchen.name: F77
Nivada Grenchen.desc: A 1970s-style integrated-bracelet sport watch, an affordable alternative to luxury designs.

Nivada Grenchen.name: Broad Arrow
Nivada Grenchen.desc: A chronograph with arrow-shaped hands, revived from a 1960s Nivada design.

Ollech & Wajs.name: C-1000
Ollech & Wajs.desc: A revival of the Caribbean 1000 tool diver, a 1000m-rated watch with a cult 1960s following.

Ollech & Wajs.name: M-Series (M-110, MK-102, MV-82)
Ollech & Wajs.desc: Reissues of military-style watches from the 1960s and 70s, simple, rugged and legible.

Ollech & Wajs.name: P-101
Ollech & Wajs.desc: A clean military-style field watch that relaunched the brand; older batches may be sold out.

Ollech & Wajs.name: Early Bird EB-24
Ollech & Wajs.desc: A 1960s 24-hour dial design brought back with a blue and red bezel and 300m rating.

Ollech & Wajs.name: Astrochron
Ollech & Wajs.desc: A dive chronograph with a sailing countdown, an inner dive bezel and an outer compass bezel.

Lorier.name: Neptune
Lorier.desc: A 1960s-style diver with a domed crystal and gilt dial, the brand's best-known watch.

Lorier.name: Falcon
Lorier.desc: A small, everyday vintage-style sport watch with a domed crystal, inspired by 1950s designs.

Lorier.name: Hyperion
Lorier.desc: A vintage-styled travel watch that tracks a second time zone, at a low price for a GMT.

Lorier.name: Astra
Lorier.desc: A simple, retro everyday watch with an easy-to-read dial.

Lorier.name: Olympia
Lorier.desc: A vintage-style chronograph that replaced the Gemini, a big step up for the brand.

Nodus.name: Contrail
Nodus.desc: A travel watch with a 12-hour bezel and a second time zone hand, made in Los Angeles.

Nodus.name: Sector II
Nodus.desc: A modular range of field, dive and GMT watches at a sensible everyday size.

Nodus.name: Duality II
Nodus.desc: A slim, modern 200m diver with crisp finishing, one of the best tool watches under $1,000.

Nodus.name: Retrospect III
Nodus.desc: A vintage-style diver with a layered sandwich dial, the brand's entry-level model.

Nodus.name: Avalon
Nodus.desc: A cushion-cased 300m diver inspired by 1970s dive watches.

Oris.name: Big Crown Pointer Date
Oris.desc: A classic pilot's watch whose date is shown by a red-tipped center hand, made since 1938.

Oris.name: Aquis
Oris.movement: Automatic, Sellita base or in-house Calibre 400
Oris.desc: Oris's modern 300m dive watch with an integrated-style bracelet and ceramic bezel.

Oris.name: Divers Sixty-Five
Oris.desc: A vintage-styled diver based on a 1965 Oris design, with domed crystal and warm lume.

Oris.name: ProPilot
Oris.movement: Automatic, Sellita base or in-house Calibre 400
Oris.desc: A modern aviation watch with a bezel like a jet engine, including the titanium ProPilot X.

Longines.name: Spirit
Longines.desc: A COSC-certified pilot's watch inspired by Longines' aviation history, a strong value Swiss automatic.

Longines.name: Conquest
Longines.desc: A modern steel everyday sport watch on a bracelet, 100m water resistant with a 72-hour reserve.

Longines.name: HydroConquest
Longines.desc: Longines' everyday 300m diver with a ceramic bezel, a good-value Swiss dive watch.

Longines.name: Legend Diver
Longines.desc: A 1960s-style diver with the bezel inside the dial, turned by a second crown.

Longines.name: Spirit Zulu Time
Longines.desc: A true travel GMT watch with a jumping local hour hand, sold well below rivals.

Longines.name: Master Collection
Longines.desc: The classic dress line, from simple three-hand models to moonphase and chronograph versions.

Tudor.name: Black Bay 58
Tudor.desc: A vintage-inspired 39mm diver that became Tudor's bestseller and a modern classic.

Tudor.name: Black Bay GMT / 58 GMT
Tudor.desc: A travel watch with a red and blue 24-hour bezel, Tudor's answer to luxury GMTs.

Tudor.name: Black Bay Pro
Tudor.desc: A rugged explorer-style GMT with a fixed 24-hour bezel and bright yellow GMT hand.

Tudor.name: Pelagos
Tudor.desc: A light titanium professional diver, including the 500m Pelagos 42 and the military FXD.

Tudor.name: Ranger
Tudor.desc: A simple explorer-style field watch with a 3-6-9 dial and 70-hour power reserve.

Tudor.name: Black Bay 54
Tudor.desc: A small 37mm diver based on Tudor's first 1954 dive watch, with a minimal bezel.
